## Purpose

Describe the smallest problem this pull request closes. State whether it changes documentation, theory, protocol, implementation, tests, packaging, or community governance.

## Evidence and scope

- Target version or document:

## Invariant and compatibility audit

Explain any effect on field contracts, center scope, partial-order legality, dynamic addresses, Focus-1 authorization, Focus-2 expansion, closure, residuals, `Fold/Unwind`, legacy schema compatibility, license, or release history. Write “none” only after checking the relevant layer.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. For theory-only changes, describe the contradiction, source, link, and downstream-document checks instead of presenting code tests as philosophical proof.

## Checklist

- [ ] I targeted the current authoritative version or explicitly marked a historical correction.
- [ ] I separated definitions, hypotheses, implementation claims, and empirical evidence.
- [ ] I added or updated regression evidence when behavior changed.
- [ ] I checked public links, private data, credentials, and local absolute paths.
- [ ] I documented migration or compatibility effects.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this material under CC BY-NC 4.0.
